about:
Wyoming Welding & Machine LLC operates from Sheridan, Wyoming, where founder Daniel Johlman started the company out of a desire to build a wider variety of challenging projects. What began as a personal passion for fabrication has grown into a full-service metal fabrication shop serving customers across the region.

The shop provides laser cutting, forming, machining, welding, and assembly as a turnkey operation. A Trumpf fiber laser handles mild steel up to 1 inch, stainless up to 3/4 inch, aluminum up to 5/8 inch, and titanium, copper, and brass up to 3/8 inch. The company processes thousands of pounds of titanium annually and delivers structural steel packages for multi-million-dollar residential and commercial projects, along with architectural metalwork coordinated with design firms and general contractors.

Customers span chemical, marine, energy, construction, aerospace, and industrial product sectors, as well as architectural and structural markets in Wyoming and Montana. General contractors rely on the firm for structural steel fabrication and erection, while design and engineering firms engage the shop for design-to-production integration on custom metal projects.

Johlman states he founded the business to pursue more challenging builds and to create a company that serves customers better than they have been served before, emphasizing a commitment to expanding capabilities and team development alongside project growth.
